_comment: User-facing names and 1-line descriptions for every 'oneclick' app in manifests/flatpaks.txt. The build fails if an app is missing here. Copy rules apply: second person, no em dashes, no exclamation marks.
org.kde.krita: Paint and sketch, with or without a drawing tablet.
com.obsproject.Studio: Record your screen or stream it live.
org.kde.digikam: Sort, tag, and back up a big photo library.
org.mozilla.Thunderbird: Read your email, calendars, and news feeds.
org.signal.Signal: Messages that only you and your contacts can read.
com.bitwarden.desktop: A password manager that syncs across your devices.
org.onionshare.OnionShare: Share files over Tor with no company in the middle.
com.nextcloud.desktopclient.nextcloud: Sync files with a Nextcloud server you or your group run.
com.vscodium.codium: A code editor without the telemetry.
io.podman_desktop.PodmanDesktop: Run containers from a point-and-click window.
net.supertuxkart.SuperTuxKart: Kart racing with Tux and friends.
org.luanti.luanti: Build worlds block by block. Fully open source.
